baseline.description: The working baseline contains later middle-end specification work, while the front-end lowering obligations remain those introduced by specification revision 1.9.57 and contract scope AA.

declaredCapabilities: A file-scope register-with-asm declaration has no allocation site and emits no EvoIR global.
A read or write of a global register variable reports E3035 at the use.
A completed array redeclaration uses the symbol's composite semantic identity.
The non-bit-vector integer lowering class has a stable code other than E3101.
The non-integer scalar lowering class has a different stable code other than E3101.

declaredFailures.observed: AllocationSiteManifest::derive returns ObjectStorageMismatch for Register versus canonical Register.
Lowering stops before the use with E3101 generated invalid EvoIR: cannot derive the authoritative allocation-site manifest instead of E3035.
Lowering returns E3101 object declaration disagrees with its semantic identity.
Both independent singleton classes still report E3101.

protectedExistingBehavior.result: PASS: E2928 at the address operator
PASS: manifest derivation and lowering both succeed

workspaceRun.result: Every pre-existing test target passed; the new lowering_diagnostic_frontier target had exactly its four declared failures and two passes.

authorityGap.finding: Revision 1.9.57 requires a distinct code for every remaining lowering class but the diagnostic registry assigns neither a code nor a normative message to the non-bit-vector integer and non-integer scalar singleton classes.
authorityGap.requiredRuling: Assign the two stable diagnostic codes and messages before production code or the next lowering survey encodes them.
authorityGap.notAssumed: The test deliberately does not guess that the next available spellings are E3036 and E3037.

claimCeiling: This checkpoint proves four executable RED failures plus two protected baseline behaviors. It makes no implementation, publication, or lowering-survey claim.
